Description: MinuteClinic is a limited Service Health Care Clinic staffed by a practitioner located inside CVS/pharmacy. These practitioners specialize in family health care and are trained to diagnose, treat, and write prescriptions for common family illnesses. They also administer common vaccinations and offer wellness services, including sports and camp physicals screenings and monitoring for diabetes, high blood pressure and high cholesterol, and programs for weight loss and smoking cessation. See http://www.minuteclinic.com/ for a detailed listing of services.

Description: Seedough's is a bakery, introducing Mediterranean backed goods and confectionaries, as well as other light food items to the Berkeley and beyond. We will be operating Seedough's as the primary food service at the 2309 Food Garden. The restaurant itself is about 200 square feet and does not have seating, however the outdoor area, formally a parking lot has been converted to an outdoor seating area. On a side note, the original business license application (BLA-2021-000583) was originally under Afghan Burrito LLC, we decided to move it to a trailer and utilize Seedough's for the building. Is possible to change the name on the business license application?
